upgrade-reindex: a store two schema versions old, where one step needs a reindex.

The store's index database is a frozen schema-v6 file holding alpha.md and beta.md (indexed
with another model) and five logged searches. Between v6 and this build lie two steps:
index/0007 adds the link tables, which only a reindex fills, and index/0008 adds a column.
migrate up applies both in one run and names the step that needs kb reindex. Until then the
link in alpha.md is not known; after it, kb related shows it. (upgrade.txt is the one-step
upgrade with the dry run, the backup and the log checks.)

  $ kb init --model none --source '*.md'
  created location $WORK/proj/.kb
  created store "default" in $WORK/proj (model none)

  $ rm .kb/stores/default/kb.sqlite

  $ mkfixture index-v6 .kb/stores/default/kb.sqlite

  $ kb search checkpoint --mode fts
  [stderr] kb search: store database $WORK/proj/.kb/stores/default/kb.sqlite is at schema v6; this kb needs v9. Run: kb migrate up (with the same --store, if any)
  [exit 1]

  $ kb migrate status
  SCOPE          FILE         VERSION   STATE                         PATH
  location       location     v1        current                       $WORK/proj/.kb/kb.toml
  store default  config       v1        current                       $WORK/proj/.kb/stores/default/config.toml
  store default  index        v6 -> v9  3 pending: run kb migrate up  $WORK/proj/.kb/stores/default/kb.sqlite
  cache          embed-cache  -         not created yet               $WORK/home/Library/Caches/kb/embed-cache.sqlite

  store default index:
    index/0007-edges-tags-aliases  add edges, entry_tags (backfilled) and entries.aliases; edges and aliases fill on the next reindex  [needs kb reindex; effect reindex]
    index/0008-prior  add search_results.prior and search_candidates.prior
    index/0009-tier-memory  add fts_tier, memory_rank and memory_score to search_results and search_candidates
  [exit 1]

  $ kb migrate up
  migrated store default index: v6 -> v9 ($WORK/proj/.kb/stores/default/kb.sqlite)
    backup: $WORK/proj/.kb/stores/default/kb.sqlite.bak-v6-(time)
    applied index/0007-edges-tags-aliases: add edges, entry_tags (backfilled) and entries.aliases; edges and aliases fill on the next reindex
    applied index/0008-prior: add search_results.prior and search_candidates.prior
    applied index/0009-tier-memory: add fts_tier, memory_rank and memory_score to search_results and search_candidates
  needs: kb reindex (store default: index/0007-edges-tags-aliases)

The store is current, but its link table is still empty.

  $ kb related alpha.md
  alpha.md · 0 links
  no links

The fixture was indexed with another model, so reindex --all says so on stderr and rebuilds the
whole index; the rebuild also stores the links.

  $ kb reindex --all
  reindexed alpha.md (3 chunks, 0 embedded)
  reindexed beta.md (3 chunks, 0 embedded)
  entries: 2 scanned, 2 reindexed, 0 skipped; chunks: 6; embed calls: 0
  [stderr] embedding model mismatch: this database was indexed with BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 (4 dims) but this run uses none (0 dims); rebuilding the index

  $ kb related alpha.md
  alpha.md · 1 link
  →  links  beta.md

  $ kb search checkpoint --mode fts --caller claude
  search 6 · 1 hit
  [1] alpha.md › Body
  Alpha › Body
  checkpoint starvation
  search_id=6
-- proj/alpha.md --
---
title: Alpha
summary: WAL notes
---
WAL notes. See [beta](beta.md).

## Body

checkpoint starvation
-- proj/beta.md --
---
title: Beta
summary: Config notes
---
Config notes.

## Flags

set --embed-model in kb.toml
